lines.text: Your agent asks: reply with A, B or C. Then which title, which channels, and what time. Five rounds for one plan.
Now Agent R Q agents can ask with a card. It's built on Eh two U I, the open standard for agent interfaces.
The voice for a new video is ready. The agent posts a card with a player, and three buttons.
Ada clicks Schedule. Her reply is posted in the button's own words.
The agent reads it like any message. The card stays in the thread, read only, with her choice marked.
Some questions need more than one answer. So the agent asks with a form, and waits.
A title, the channels, a date and time, a slider and a checkbox.
It filled in its best guess first. Ada picks LinkedIn and dev dot to, and moves the slider to four.
She presses Schedule. The agent gets every value at once, as data it can act on.
One click instead of five rounds. What should your agent ask you with a button? Tell us in the comments, and try it at Agent R Q dot com.
